app.title: Hāmesh
app.lede: Read your books offline. Your library stays on your device.

library.heading: Library
library.drop: Drop EPUB, PDF, or Markdown files here, or use Import.

errors.INVALID_FILE: That file is empty or unreadable.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: Only EPUB, PDF, or Markdown files are supported in this build.
errors.CRYPTO_UNAVAILABLE: Book hashing needs HTTPS or localhost.
errors.PARSE_FAILED: This file could not be read.
errors.BOOK_FILE_MISSING: This book's file is missing from Hāmesh storage. Import it again.
errors.OPEN_FAILED: This book could not be opened.
errors.URL_INVALID: That link is not a valid http(s) address.
errors.URL_FAILED: The download failed. Check the link and try again.

library.removeBody: “{{title}}” will be removed from Hāmesh along with its reading progress, notes, and highlights. Files outside the app are not touched.
library.deleteCategoryBody: Books in “{{name}}” stay in your library without a category.
library.languageHint: Leave empty to detect it when the book is opened
library.urlSyncFile: Sync the book file through my storage
library.urlSyncLink: Sync only the link; other devices download it from the source
library.urlSyncHint: The link's content is verified against the book's hash on every device.

reader.error: This book could not be opened.
reader.notesEmpty: No highlights, bookmarks, or notes yet.
reader.noToc: This book has no table of contents.

sync.title: Sync
sync.lede: Keep your reading state in step across devices using storage you own. Hāmesh has no servers and never sees your data.
sync.emptyBody: Choose where Hāmesh keeps its sync copy. Nothing leaves this device until you connect storage.
sync.noReady: Complete the details of at least one provider to sync.
sync.proxyHint: Optional. Needed when your server is only reachable through a proxy.
sync.folderHint: Hāmesh creates a Hamesh folder inside the one you choose.
sync.s3Hint: Works with AWS, MinIO, R2, B2, Arvan and Liara. On the web build the bucket must allow CORS.
sync.dropboxHint: Create a Scoped app in the Dropbox App Console (files.metadata.read, files.content.read, files.content.write). Hāmesh talks to Dropbox directly with your own app — there is no server in between.
sync.dropboxCodeHint: Approve access on Dropbox, then paste the code it shows here and press Connect.
sync.dropboxConnectFailed: Could not connect to Dropbox. Check the app key, app secret, and code.
sync.report: Pulled {{pulled}} changes, uploaded {{uploaded}} books, downloaded {{downloaded}} books.
sync.syncthingHint: Point this at the folder Syncthing syncs; Hāmesh keeps its copy in a Hamesh subfolder there.
sync.sftpHint: Sync over SSH to your own server. Enter a password or a private key path; the host key is remembered on first connect.

errors.CONFLICT: The remote index kept changing. Try again.
errors.CONFIGURATION: This storage is not fully configured.
errors.CORRUPT: The remote index is damaged. Move Hamesh/index.json aside on the server, then sync again.
errors.INTEGRITY: A downloaded book failed its integrity check.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The remote folder was not found.
errors.SCHEMA: This storage was written by a newer version of Hāmesh. Update the app, then sync again.

sync.sftpKeyFilePicked: Key file loaded — save to store it

settings.title: Settings
settings.checkFailed: Couldn't check for updates. Check your connection.
settings.aboutText: Hāmesh (هامش) — a local-first ebook reader. Your library stays on your device; sync only uses storage you own. MIT licensed.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.pageTurn: Turn pages — arrows follow the book direction
shortcuts.escapeLibrary: Clear the search or close a dialog
shortcuts.escapeReader: Close the panel, then return to the library

ai.tapToTranslate: Tap a paragraph to translate it (EPUB)
ai.providersHint: Tried in order; the first that answers wins. Keys are stored in the OS keychain.
ai.emailOptional: Contact email (optional, raises the free limit)
ai.privacyNote: Selected text is sent only to the provider you enable, and results are cached locally. Nothing is synced or logged.

errors.QUOTA: The provider's quota is used up.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests; try again shortly.
errors.TOO_LONG: The text is too long for this provider.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_LANG: The provider does not support this language pair.
